# Gradle wrapper provenance

This project includes the official Gradle **v8.11.1** wrapper JAR from:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gradle/gradle/v8.11.1/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar

Its SHA-256 was checked against the published Gradle wrapper checksum. The matching gradlew and gradlew.bat scripts are from the same tag. The pinned distribution URL also has a verified distributionSha256Sum in gradle-wrapper.properties.

The earlier source-built wrapper has been replaced with the official artifact. Source license: Apache-2.0, included as APACHE-2.0.txt.
